summary: Petrobras filed Form 6-K reporting its agreement to acquire a 50% interest in the Itaimbezinho exploration block in the Campos Basin from Equinor Brasil Energia Ltda., which currently holds 100%. No price per share, premium, or implied value are disclosed. The consortium post-close will be Equinor (operator, 50%), Petrobras (50%), and PPSA as manager. The transaction aligns with Petrobras's 2026-2030 business plan. Completion is subject to approval from CADE and ANP, plus other precedent conditions. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and any competitive concerns in Brazil's offshore exploration market.
